instruction: Please configure Chrome to clear all cookies and site data automatically when I close the browser.

metadata.explanation: Task requires configuring Chrome to clear cookies on exit. Custom getter get_chrome_clear_cookies_on_exit__37d7b439 checks Chrome Preferences for cookie clearing settings, including clear_cookies_on_exit flag and cookies set to session-only mode (value 4). Returns 'true' when configured to clear on exit.
metadata.verification: Custom getter checks multiple Chrome Preferences fields related to cookie deletion on exit, including session-only cookie mode.
